name: Nordic Council

flag.description: A blue field with a white swan in flight inside a white ring in the centre.
flag.symbolism: The flying swan is the shared symbol of official Nordic co-operation, used by both the Nordic Council and the Nordic Council of Ministers.

hook: The Nordic Council flies a white swan, wings swept back in long feathers, inside a white ring on blue.
trivia: The swan was redrawn in 2016 as part of a common visual identity for official Nordic co-operation.
The Faroe Islands, Greenland and Åland sit in the council alongside Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway and Sweden.
